No new imperative or mutability debt found.

Each projection row is covered by the row-completeness guard in [command_exit_code_projection_tests.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/tests/command_exit_code_projection_tests.rs:762), with classifier and subprocess bindings.
